requirements.scope: 主干固定状态；H8信用元信息只含head/query/读权/正步长/valid，不含m/p/x/slow副本

requirements.requirement: 同一外部信号先经过各节点自己的状态条件外部映射，再影响内部写入
requirements.scope: A_i=diag(1+.1tanhD)+.15u_i v_i^T；value/key均映射，最终tick同一观测进入fast、Joseph、innovation、trace/query

requirements.requirement: 不确定性实际影响更新、读取与耦合，且长期数值范围可控
requirements.scope: latent Gaussian滤波近似；受控增益+Joseph保PSD，m另投影到范数4；并非完整非线性后验或已校准事实确信

requirements.requirement: 保留有限时间带、动态多频Fourier、局部相位耦合及其真实路径作用
requirements.scope: 单模式+相邻交叉项，未构造无限Fourier组合；同步/分群本身不算能力证据

requirements.requirement: 实心球体的有限壳离散、中心注入、向外强度门槛、允许向内回落
requirements.scope: 每节点8固定候选，构图阶段距离O(N^2)，推理传播O(Nkd^2)；无运行时全连接两两图

requirements.requirement: 误差信号修订对应经验子空间，精确核对实际直接读取路径
requirements.scope: head+实际query/weight条件VJP精确；完整间接动态信用由BPTT承担，缓存query/weight/head元信息固定为一阶资格记录

requirements.requirement: 扩大节点数时有效写入速度不能被均匀归一读悄悄稀释
requirements.scope: E=(sum a)^2/sum a^2，positive scale=E/32；none配对保留；不除掉共同confidence总幅度，不承诺任意异质query完全等价

requirements.requirement: 迟到反馈使用对应过去query，不把误差写到当前无关query
requirements.scope: H=8；1..8显式lag一次消费，>8拒绝；optimizer更新失效全部head版本。自然LM主训练仍只用下一token自然lag1反馈，未宣称自动语义延迟归因

requirements.requirement: 修订当前经验不能经全局限幅缩放无关正交慢经验
requirements.scope: 仅投影S q子空间，保S_perp；剩余容量耗尽时无法新增正交内容，明确记录capacity_clip_fraction/有效步长；语义是否学到正交仍需训练检验

requirements.requirement: 短动态清除后仍可检查慢经验；有独立清slow的因果对照
requirements.scope: reset_fast仅保slow+support，clear_slow保fast/p/support且使信用缓存失效；原构想长期参数巩固规则仍开放，不额外发明持久权重在线巩固器

requirements.requirement: 无效位置只影响损失/诊断掩码，不能成为外部反馈或情境控制信号
requirements.scope: model diagnostic_mask不改变任何state或logits；每有效token/lane聚合，min/max保留对应统计

requirements.requirement: 不引入JEPA、完整路径历史、情境网络副本、新优化器、额外动态专家创建
requirements.scope: 动态功能群从已有有效通路与矩阵活动中检验；不把未实现的新优化器/聚类误列为本轮缺失机制

numeric_bounds.m_x_slow: Each dxd matrix Frobenius norm <=4 from valid initial state; m update uses full matrix projection, slow update preserves query-orthogonal component
numeric_bounds.p: lambda_max <=1+(Q+1e-6)/(1-rho), rho=exp(-1/tau), default bound 9.19709654071045; exact arithmetic with FP32 stress recorded separately
numeric_bounds.innovation: EMA of mapped value error; loose parameter-independent upper bound 25 for d>=4 and ||m||F<=4
numeric_bounds.z: Unit circle coordinates, renormalized each internal tick; floating tolerance applies
numeric_bounds.read_query: Each vector norm <=1, zero query allowed
numeric_bounds.read_scale: [0,N/reference] in participation mode; 1 in none mode
numeric_bounds.evidence_count: Diagnostic counter saturates at 2^31-1, never used as hidden history control
numeric_bounds.feedback_and_credit_prediction: Conditional on fixed finite embedding parameters: norm <=max_j ||embedding_j||
numeric_bounds.feedback_and_credit_h: Conditional on fixed finite read projection: norm <=sqrt(80)*||R||op; bypass additionally max embedding norm
numeric_bounds.credit_cache: Exactly H=8 metadata frames of fixed dimensions; boolean validity cleared on optimizer version change

complexity.history_dependence: H=8 is explicit fixed credit metadata, never node-state/context copies
